navigation-label.purpose: Compact title-case navigation labels, 14px desktop and 16px mobile.

shadows.name: navigation-glass
shadows.purpose: Bounded depth and the bright material edge of the shared glass navigation.

motion.name: primary-transition
motion.purpose: Primary action hover and press states.

motion.name: navigation-selection
motion.purpose: Current-page selection continuity; immediate for keyboard, resize, and reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The default terracotta action used for a clear next step.
components.css: .ds-button { background: var(--accent); color: var(--canvas); border: 0; border-radius: 0; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 19.2px; font: 600 14px/1.4 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease, transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-button:hover { background: var(--accent-hover); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-button:active { background: var(--accent-pressed); transform: scale(.97); }

components.name: Booking Action
components.description: A light action control in the terracotta booking band.
components.css: .ds-booking { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; min-height: 52px; padding: 14px 20px; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); border-radius: 0; font: 500 15px/1.4 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-booking:hover { background: var(--surface); } .ds-booking:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--paper); outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Liquid Glass Navigation
components.description: Three-zone header with a 19px left logo inset, centered 50%-opacity glass navigation, a coral desktop registration capsule matching the homepage action, and content-aware mobile collapse.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: inline-flex; gap: 4px; padding: 4px; color: var(--ink); background: rgba(250,250,247,.5); border: 1px solid rgba(250,250,247,.48); border-radius: 999px; backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(160%); box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(15,15,14,.12), inset 0 1px 1px rgba(250,250,247,.8); } .ds-nav a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 999px; color: inherit; font: 500 14px/1.5 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a[aria-current='page'] { background: rgba(250,250,247,.84); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: -4px; }

components.name: Destination Tabs
components.description: Equal-width venue and hotel choices with a moving active indicator.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-tabs button { position: relative; flex: 1; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 12px 12px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--muted); font: 500 14px/1.4 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-tabs button[aria-selected='true'] { color: var(--accent); } .ds-tabs button[aria-selected='true']::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: auto 0 -1px; height: 2px; background: var(--accent); } .ds-tabs button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Street Grid Schematic
components.description: A quiet, explicitly not-to-scale location marker paired with real directions.
components.html: WEST 59TH STREETSchematic · not to scale
components.css: .ds-map { position: relative; height: 240px; overflow: hidden; background-color: var(--surface); background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, transparent 0 42px, var(--paper) 42px 58px), repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 62px, var(--paper) 62px 78px); color: var(--muted); font: 600 11px/1.4 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-map span { position: absolute; top: 42%; left: 16px; } .ds-map i { position: absolute; top: 52%; left: 45%; width: 18px; height: 18px; background: var(--accent); border: 5px solid var(--paper); border-radius: 50%; outline: 8px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 18%, transparent); } .ds-map small { position: absolute; right: 12px; bottom: 10px; padding: 5px 8px; background: var(--paper); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0; }

narrative.overview: The visual language treats event information as a clear guide through a public institution: calm, legible, and anchored in place. Source Serif 4 gives headings an editorial voice; IBM Plex Sans keeps navigation, addresses, and practical details direct. Warm neutral surfaces and hairline rules organize the pages. The venue experience makes room for each step of a visit, while the landing page uses a darker skyline hero with a brighter coral accent as a local variation.
keyCharacteristics: Editorial serif headings paired with functional sans-serif text.
Warm neutral surfaces, charcoal ink, and terracotta actions.
Open layouts organized by spacing, contrast, and thin rules.
Square content controls paired with light liquid-glass navigation and a moving selection pill.

rules.name: The One Action Accent Rule
rules.body: Use terracotta to mark actions and active wayfinding. The coral pair belongs to the dark landing hero, where it maintains contrast over the skyline image.

rules.name: The Two Voice Rule
rules.body: Keep display headings in Source Serif 4 and functional text in IBM Plex Sans; use weight and size to establish hierarchy rather than bolding every heading.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Keep resting content flat. The user-requested glass navigation is the only shared-shell material exception; do not spread its blur, rounded forms, or shadows into page content.

dos: Do keep Source Serif 4 for display headings and IBM Plex Sans for functional text.
Do use the terracotta accent for actions, active states, and wayfinding.
Do preserve open section spacing, square content controls, and visible keyboard focus; keep the glass treatment scoped to navigation.
Do label schematic maps as not to scale and link directions to a real map service.
donts: Don't add shadowed cards as the default layout; current hierarchy comes from spacing, fills, and hairlines.
Don't imply a walking route or geographic accuracy in the schematic map.
Don't publish unconfirmed room, entrance, or program details as facts.
